caption: The image depicts a rectangular rug with a predominantly beige and brown color scheme, featuring accents in red, pink, blue, and darker brown. The central motif is an oval shape outlined in red, with a geometric, symmetrical design inside that includes intersecting arcs and a small central circle, incorporating shades of beige, brown, and red. Surrounding the central oval are four red floral or abstract elements set against a beige background with brown and blue detailing. The border consists of several bands in beige, brown, red, and blue, with the corners marked by red triangular sections. The texture of the rug appears looped and raised, indicative of a hooked or tufted rug construction. In the bottom right corner, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Hooked Rug (Cotton)
